scenarios.title: Undying returns a creature with no +1/+1 counter
decisions: B casts Shock targeting Young Wolf, tapping Mountain.
Both players pass; Shock resolves and Young Wolf is dealt 2 damage.
If undying triggers, both players pass and it resolves.

variants.label: no_counter
variants.expected: Young Wolf (1/1) is destroyed by the state-based check and goes to A's graveyard. Its undying trigger fires and resolves: Young Wolf returns to the battlefield under A's control with a +1/+1 counter and is 2/2.

variants.label: has_counter
variants.delta: Young Wolf already has one +1/+1 counter (it is 2/2).
variants.expected: Young Wolf is dealt 2 damage and is destroyed. It had a +1/+1 counter, so undying does not trigger. Young Wolf stays in A's graveyard.

scenarios.title: Undying returns the creature under its owner's control

setup.notes: Young Wolf is owned by A but controlled by B, who gained control of it on an earlier turn with a control-changing effect that lasts indefinitely.

decisions: A casts Shock targeting Young Wolf, tapping Mountain.
Both players pass; Shock resolves and Young Wolf is dealt 2 damage.
If undying triggers, both players pass and it resolves.

variants.label: owned_by_A
variants.expected: Young Wolf is destroyed and goes to A's graveyard, its owner's. The undying trigger resolves and Young Wolf returns to the battlefield under A's control with a +1/+1 counter (2/2). B no longer controls it.

variants.label: owned_by_B
variants.delta: Young Wolf is owned and controlled by B.
variants.expected: Young Wolf is destroyed and goes to B's graveyard. The undying trigger resolves and Young Wolf returns to the battlefield under B's control with a +1/+1 counter (2/2).

variants.label: has_counter
variants.delta: Young Wolf already has one +1/+1 counter (it is 2/2).
variants.expected: Young Wolf is destroyed and goes to A's graveyard, its owner's. It had a +1/+1 counter, so undying does not trigger and it stays there.

scenarios.forge_notes: Control of a card owned by the other player is hard to reach in a puzzle setup; it may need an Aura or control-changing effect played first.
